web.title: ACT Leave – Leave that travels
web.description:
# Leave that travels with you
From 1 January 2027, the Services Industry Scheme will expand to include hairdressing and beauty services and food and accommodation services.

[Register for the Services Industry Scheme](https://portal.actleave.act.gov.au/Public/CompanyRegister#/step1)

## Latest updates
##### Change to entry date for new industries to Services Industry Scheme
On 3 May 2026, the Minister for Skills, Training and Industrial Relations announced that the entry of the hair and beauty and accommodation and food services industries into the Services Industry Scheme will be delayed until 1 January 2027. This is in response to the challenging conditions many businesses are currently experiencing.

The Minister also announced additional relief for food and beverage businesses, with phased levy discounts over the first three years of the scheme. These discounts will not affect workers’ entitlements.

##### Important update: Changes to the Services Industry Scheme
[Read more](https://actleave.act.gov.au/important-update-changes-to-the-services-industry-scheme/)

##### Pre-register for the Services Industry Scheme
[Read more](https://actleave.act.gov.au/services/)

##### Learn more about the Services Industry Scheme
The scheme incorporates the existing Contract Cleaning Industry Scheme and new industries of hairdressing and beauty services and accommodation and food services, including hospitality services.

[Read more](https://actleave.act.gov.au/learn-more-about-the-services-industry-scheme/)

##### New Services Industry Scheme
Portable Long Service Leave has been expanded to allow workers in the hairdressing, beauty, accommodation and food services industries to accrue long service leave.

[Read more](https://actleave.act.gov.au/articles/new-services-industry-scheme/)
